character.name: Vorys
traits: Mastermind Strategist: Can read a room in seconds, identifying power dynamics and hidden weaknesses in any social gathering.
Charming Liar: Can lie with perfect, unshakable sincerity, making even the most outlandish deception seem true.
Cold Calculator: Views all living beings as disposable tools, valuing them only for their utility in his schemes.
Guilt Weaver: Specializes in unearthing others' hidden shame, using it to bind them to his will with unbreakable psychological chains.
character.gear: Masterwork rapier · Burgundy leather armor · Spider-etched thieves' tools · Paralytic poison vial · House Voryn signet ring · 3 days dried trail rations · 50 ft dark silk rope · Locked blackmail journal
character.story: Vorys grew up in the gilded, rotting halls of a fallen noble house, learning early that tears were currency and loyalty a fatal flaw. At 16, he framed his elder brother for a murder he committed, seizing the family's remaining assets and watching his brother hang without a flicker of remorse. Now he drifts through the city's underbelly, weaving a web of blackmail and false loyalty, counting the days until he holds every power broker by a single frayed thread.

inventory.name: Masterwork rapier
inventory.lore: A slender, unadorned rapier taken from the disgraced knight he framed for a noble's murder. The black leather hilt is worn smooth by his constant practice with the blade.
inventory.description: Slender, balanced rapier ideal for precise, lethal thrusts.

inventory.name: Burgundy leather armor
inventory.lore: Soft, supple leather dyed deep burgundy, stolen from his family's armory before he faked his own death. The faint crest of House Voryn is still visible, worn off at the seams.
inventory.description: Lightweight, quiet leather armor offering flexible protection.

inventory.name: Spider-etched thieves' tools
inventory.lore: A set of polished lockpicks and tension wrenches stolen from a master thief he framed for a noble's murder. Each pick is etched with a tiny spider sigil, the symbol of his growing network of pawns.
inventory.description: Fine set of lockpicks and infiltration tools for bypassing locks and traps.

inventory.name: Paralytic poison vial
inventory.lore: A tiny crystal vial of pale purple poison distilled from cave moss, purchased from a disgraced apothecary he now controls. It causes paralysis within seconds of skin contact.
inventory.description: Single-use vial of fast-acting paralytic poison.
inventory.effects: DC 13 CON save or paralyzed for 1 minute on contact with skin.

inventory.name: House Voryn signet ring
inventory.lore: Heavy gold signet ring bearing the crest of his birth noble house. He keeps it as a reminder of the life he destroyed, and uses its crest to forge documents for his network of pawns.
inventory.description: Gold signet ring with the crest of House Voryn, usable to forge official documents.
inventory.effects: 3 uses per day: forges documents that pass even noble scrutiny, granting advantage on deception checks related to official paperwork.

inventory.name: Dried trail rations
inventory.lore: Dried, salted strips of venison and hard flatbread, scavenged from the ruins of the noble estate he burned to cover his tracks. They still smell faintly of ash.
inventory.description: Three days of preserved, nutrient-dense trail rations.

inventory.name: Dark silk rope (50ft)
inventory.lore: A length of smooth, dark silk rope stolen from a ship captain he blackmailed into smuggling his contacts out of the city. It is strong enough to hold a grown man's weight without fraying.
inventory.description: 50-foot length of lightweight, durable dark silk rope.

inventory.name: Locked blackmail journal
inventory.lore: A leather-bound locked journal filled with names, secrets, and compromising evidence on every noble, merchant, and guildmaster in the city's lower ward. He has spent two years compiling it, one ruined life at a time.
inventory.description: Locked leather journal containing blackmail material on 27 powerful city figures.
inventory.effects: Grants advantage on persuasion checks targeting any figure listed within the journal.

inventory.name: 50 ft dark silk rope
inventory.lore: En liten sak från en svunnen tid — värdelös för de flesta, ovärderlig för dig.
